FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'My father is called David.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon père s'appelle David.
   B. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   C. C'est ma sœur.
   D. C'est le bébé.

2. What does 'la cuisine' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the living room
   B. the bathroom
   C. the door
   D. the kitchen

3. What does 'je chante' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. I sing
   C. I play
   D. today

4. Fill in: lundi, mardi, ______, jeudi. (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. dimanche
   C. mercredi
   D. samedi

5. How do you say 'On Sunday, I rest.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le vendredi, je danse.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   D. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.

6. What number is 'vingt' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 20

7. What number is 'quinze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 15
   C. 9
   D. 10

8. How do you say 'I am nine years old.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   B. Joyeux anniversaire !
   C. J'ai neuf ans.
   D. C'est le premier janvier.

9. What does 'les haricots' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. beans
   B. maize
   C. the orange
   D. vegetables

10. What does 'le lait' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. cheese
   C. milk
   D. chips

11. How do you say 'I like milk.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   B. C'est une banane.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. J'aime le lait.

12. What does 'le bras' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ear
   B. the shoulder
   C. the arm
   D. the foot

13. What does 'grand' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tall, big
   B. long
   C. black
   D. short

14. What does 'l'orage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. the storm
   C. the cloud
   D. the weather

15. Fill in: Allez ______. (Go straight ahead.) (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. tout droit
   C. à droite
   D. à gauche

16. What does 'Bonjour, Amina !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, I am fine.
   B. I am well, thank you.
   C. Pleased to meet you!
   D. Hello, Amina!

17. What does 'Voici mon grand-père.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandmother.
   B. My sister is called Njeri.
   C. This is my sister.
   D. Here is my grandfather.

18. Which little word goes with 'bébé' (the baby)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

19. What does 'C'est une table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bag is in the bedroom.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. There is a sofa in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

20. What does 'Bon anniversaire !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sing and I dance.
   B. My birthday is on 30 June.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

21. What does 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has black hair.
   B. I have two hands.
   C. She has long hair.
   D. Touch your nose!

22. Which little word goes with 'magasin' (the shop)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

23. Which little word goes with 'clé' (the key)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

24. How do you say 'the boy' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la mère
   B. le garçon
   C. le père
   D. la sœur

25. How do you say 'on' in French? (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. sur
   C. devant
   D. sous

26. How do you say 'a cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un ballon
   B. un anniversaire
   C. un mois
   D. un gâteau

27. How do you say 'juice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le thé
   B. le jus
   C. les fruits
   D. les frites

28. How do you say 'sweets' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le thé
   B. les bonbons
   C. les haricots
   D. la banane

29. How do you say 'water' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jus
   B. les haricots
   C. le pain
   D. l'eau

30. How do you say 'the stomach' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. la jambe
   C. le ventre
   D. l'épaule

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'The TV is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux mains.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I go to church.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'Le sac est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'Il fait chaud.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'The bed is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Il fait beau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandfather.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Il y a des nuages.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'Touche ton nez !' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'This is my brother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'It is not good for your health.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Write the French words for: I dance, I rest, the week (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'Where is the cat?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Ça va bien, merci.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'My sister is called Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Le vendredi, je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

4. C — mercredi
   Wednesday comes between Tuesday and Thursday.

6. D — 20
